claims.text: Keratolytic shampoos (zinc pyrithione, selenium sulfide, or sulfur and salicylic acid) and tar shampoos, daily or every other day until dandruff is controlled, then twice a week
claims.quote: Keratolytic shampoos (zinc pyrithione, selenium sulfide, or sulfur and salicylic acid) and tar shampoos (available over the counter in the United States) used daily or every other day until dandruff is controlled and twice/week thereafter are also helpful.
